verdict.rationale: Shortcut's own marketing documents custom fields for structuring a team's process and configurable per-workflow-state story limits, so field customization and some workflow-state configuration are evidenced. The ability to define, rename or reorder workflow statuses themselves is not explicitly documented, and the evidence is thin marketing copy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating or editing workflow statuses, depth on custom field types and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Leverage custom fields to help you establish a more structured process for you and your teams.
Set story limits in each workflow state to stop work from piling up and keep everything moving smoothly.
